title: Completed matching sections surject modulo the maximal ideal
statement: In the hypotheses of completedRingMap_residue_lift, the completed comparison induces a surjection onto the quotient of Γ(E, ⊤) by the image of the completed maximal ideal.

source.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER; canonical H0 comparison reduced modulo the maximal ideal

proof.text: Choose finite generators f of the maximal ideal by Noetherianity. Mathlib gives flatness of adic completion and bijectivity on residue fields. Transport the latter across the equality of the completed maximal ideal with the mapped maximal ideal, obtaining the quotient-map hypothesis for formal gluing.
Construct the affine-chart module gluing datum X, its C-linear prime identification e, and the matching-section function k preserving the prime coordinate.

Make the completed pushout map F C-linear using its second pushout injection and pushout.inr_desc. The H0 prime coordinates span X.Mprime. Each such coordinate maps under e into range(F), with witness pushout.inl(k(h)), by pushout.inl_desc and the geometric bridge projection equation. Span monotonicity puts all of X.Mprime in the comap of range(F); surjectivity of e proves F is surjective.
Compose surjectivity of F with Mathlib Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective to obtain exactly the residue-quotient map in the existing statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER; affine-chart bridge plus a proved H0 prime-span lemma; completion properties and pushout/range argument written in Lean.

theorem completedRingMap_residue_quotient_surjective
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) :
    let P : CommRingCat := pushout D.baseMap (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)))
    Function.Surjective (fun a : P =>
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)).map
          (((ΓSpecIso (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))).inv ≫
            s.appTop).hom)) (D.completedRingMap a))
